name: Button destructive
summary: Red variant of Button for actions that delete data or that you cannot undo. Same base, properties and states as Button. Only the color tokens are different.
use: Delete, withdraw, cancel a subscription or other actions you cannot undo.
The confirm button in a Modal with Type=Destructive.
avoid: Cancel or close: that is not destructive. Use Secondary.
Warnings without an action: use Alert with Color=Warning.
anatomy: Same as Button: container, optional leading icon, label, optional trailing icon.
figmaProps: Primary to confirm, Tertiary or Link for a less prominent delete action.
reactProps: Set to true on Button or ButtonIcon. All other props are the same as Button.
behaviour: Add a confirm step (Modal) when you cannot undo the action.
a11y: Color is not the only signal: the label names the action ("Delete project").
The focus ring uses --focus-ring-error so it stays visible on red.
content: Say what will be gone: "Delete 3 files" instead of "Delete".
No "Are you sure?" on the button itself. That question belongs in the Modal title.
do: Put the destructive button on the right in the Modal footer, with "Cancel" (Secondary) next to it.
Use Tertiary destructive for a delete action in a list or table row.
dont: Run a destructive Primary straight away without a confirm step.
